name: What factors should I consider when budgeting for a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when budgeting for a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When budgeting for a bathroom remodel, consider several key factors. The largest components are typically labor costs and materials. Decide on the scope of work – a cosmetic refresh is less expensive than a full gut renovation. Factor in the cost of fixtures (toilet, sink, shower), cabinetry, countertops, flooring, and lighting. Don't forget potential costs for demolition, plumbing and electrical work, and any necessary permits. It's also wise to allocate an additional 10-20% of your budget for unforeseen expenses that may arise during the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: When budgeting, consider labor, materials, scope of work, fixtures, cabinetry, and permits. Allocate 10-20% extra for unforeseen expenses.
